description: Part C (PRD 4 §4.1.4 + PRD 1 §5.4, POSEIDON variant post Lever-1): t_root from ordered proof_tool_calls rows (sorted by call_index ASC). record_bytes_i = ULEB128(len(tool_id)) || tool_id_utf8 || args_hash(32B) || result_hash(32B) || ts(8B BE u64). leaf_i = poseidon_leaf_hash(record_to_field(record_bytes_i)) over Pallas-Fq (neptune 13.0.0, param artifact 4aeda63c...). Tree uses poseidon internal_hash; Z = poseidon_leaf_hash(record_to_field(empty)). t_root = poseidon_internal_hash(length_element(0x03,|T_log|), tree_root_top). Regenerated 2026-06-16 from the independent Python oracle scripts/poseidon_pallas.py; cross-checked vs the 3 Rust golden t_roots (troot_poseidon.rs).
